text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, such as data entry and basic customer support, so employees can focus on more interesting work. Productivity tools powered by AI help people organise their schedules, write emails faster, and make better decisions. In many companies, human-AI collaboration is becoming normal: workers use AI to solve problems, while people still bring creativity and judgement. Of course, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, but new ones are appearing, and many workers need to learn new skills. Overall, AI can make work faster and easier, but it requires careful adaptation.
